title: eat, shit & die 295
author: bpatrick
html:
I have been making a ton of comics that are normally relegated to the bonus section. I’ve been concentrating on those because they’ve been the most fun lately. But I hate having them and sitting on them. So here’s a page from series that’s usually bonus-only. It was fun to make, I hope it’s fun to read.

Please write me or comment on Facebook etc. I will try to respond.
